provenance.split: none: the whole authenticated corpus is the evaluation population, because nothing is fitted on it (decision 79's registered rule, re-registered by decision 111)
provenance.document_identity_source: # newdoc id comments from the authenticated CoNLL-U source
provenance.observation: derived case-role sequence (Level 4's states, one level down); UPOS, deprel and all token forms withheld
provenance.type_label_source: sentence-final punctuation token form: '.' declarative, '?' interrogative. PUNCT tokens carry no case role, so the label source cannot appear in the observation stream.
